Deep in the warm blue sea, little Celine the seahorse woke up and curled her tail around Mama's tail in the swaying seagrass.
Celine loved to play bubble chase. Pop, pop! She giggled as tiny bubbles wiggled up toward the shimmering light.
One big shiny bubble drifted away on a gentle current, and Celine swam after it, past the coral and far, far along.
When the bubble popped, Celine looked around. Mama? The seagrass was gone, and Mama was missing.
Her little heart went thump, thump. But Celine remembered what Mama always said: if you get lost, stay put and find a helper.
So Celine held on to a soft sea fan and waited. Then a friendly blue light glowed through the water: blink, blink.
A little round submarine hummed up beside her. Hello, I'm Officer Sonar, the police submarine. Are you lost, little one?
I can't find my mama, Celine whispered. Officer Sonar smiled kindly. Don't worry, we will find her together.
What does your mama look like? asked Officer Sonar. She's pink like me, but bigger, said Celine, with shiny pearls.
Officer Sonar switched on a warm searchlight and sent out a soft sonar song: ping, ping, ping.
They peeked into the coral garden, where Puff the pufferfish yawned. I saw a pink seahorse near the kelp forest, he said.
Off they went together to the tall kelp forest. The searchlight glowed softly between the swaying green ribbons.
Then Celine heard a voice she knew. Celine! There was Mama, swimming toward her with her pearls shining in the light.
Mama wrapped Celine in a big tail hug. You stayed put and found a helper, said Officer Sonar. You did just right!
Back home in the seagrass, Celine waved goodnight to Officer Sonar, snuggled close to Mama, and drifted off to sleep.
